capabilities: Track voice to keep your place
Float the script over video calls
Read the script aloud with text-to-speech
Control playback from a phone or Stream Deck
extras: Desktop only. ElevenLabs text-to-speech is opt-in and paid (consumes your credits); Kokoro, macOS say, and Web Speech run locally. The companion Stream Deck plugin is built but not released. Phone remote traffic is unencrypted, so use a trusted network. Runs local speech programs and writes some files outside the vault; see ATTACKSURFACE.md.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in teleprompter, so reading a script aloud during recordings or calls means losing your place.

relations.evidence: The voice-tracking matcher (speech-to-script alignment) is ported from jlecomte/voice-activated-teleprompter (MIT)
With an Elgato Prompter connected, it opens there and fills the screen with just the script
A Stream Deck plugin with live keys is built but not released yet
OBS integration — start/stop recording synced with teleprompter playback

summary: Teleprompter that auto-scrolls notes with voice tracking, a floating window, phone remote, and text-to-speech read-aloud.
